text: In Toronto, Max Renn runs a sensationalist UHF station and, sure he has found the future of television, [pirates a satellite signal showing people tortured and killed|trigger|seeing or hearing too much]. He records it eagerly, but the broadcast [plants a tumour that breeds hallucinations|rules|it gets inside you]: his television undulates when he kisses it, and [a slit opens in his abdomen to take a videotape|images|wounded and changing bodies]. Behind the signal stand men who [mean to purge viewers obsessed with sex and violence|wants|punishing sin], and Max becomes their weapon.
